request.question: My keyboard types @ when I press the quote key and I can't find the pound sign.
request.answer: It sounds like your keyboard layout is set incorrectly. 1. On Windows open Settings > Time & language > Language & region and set the keyboard to "United Kingdom". 2. On a Mac open System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources and add "British"
claims: It sounds like your keyboard layout is set incorrectly.
1. On Windows open Settings > Time & language > Language & region and set the keyboard to "United Kingdom".
2. On a Mac open System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources and add "British"

documents.text:
## Fix
If @ and " are swapped, the layout is set to US instead of UK. On Windows open **Settings > Time & language > Language & region** and set the keyboard to "United Kingdom". On a Mac open **System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources** and add "British".
